div.l: That ye ne rekene nat my vilonye
Though that I playnly speke in this matere
To telle you here wordis and hir chere
And though I speke here wordis propirly
For this ye knowe as wel as I
Who shal a tale telle aftir a man
He moste reherce as nere as he can
Euery word yf it be in his charge
Al speke he so rudely and so large
Or ellis he moste telle his tale vntrewe
Or seyn thyngis or feyne wordis newe
He m not spare al though he were his brothir
He moot as wel say o word as anothir
Crist spak hym self ful brode in holy writ
And well ye woot no vilany is it
Eke plato saith who so can it rede
The word muste be cosyn to the dede
Also I pray you for yeue it me
Al though I sette not folk in her degre
Here in thyse tales as they sholde stonde
My wit is short ye may wel vnderstonde
GRet chere made our ost to vs euerichon̄
And to sopere sette vs anon̄
He serued is with vitayll at the beste
Strong was the wyne ⁊and drynke vs liste
A semely man our host was with alle
Forto be a marchal in a lordes halle
A large man he was with yen stepe
A feyrer burgeys is ther non in chepe
